description: System-level benchmark for analytics routing, deterministic correctness, policy grounding, scenario analysis and reliability boundaries. v1.1 clarifies retrieval-retry and semantic-normalisation scoring without changing the 50 user queries.

design.note: Lightweight answer markers are used only where structured traces cannot fully capture semantic boundary handling.

cases.query: How many rural Centre-Based Care services are in Queensland? Give me the dataset count, not the risk-eligible count.
Count rural Centre-Based Care services in New South Wales.
How many Victorian services in the dataset are rated Working Towards NQS?
How many Family Day Care services are recorded in Western Australia?
Give me the service profile for approval SE-40000427. I only need its recorded profile, not a risk assessment.
Look up SE-40015803 and tell me its name, state and approved capacity. Do not score it unless I ask.
What is the count of rural Centre-Based Care services in South Australia?
How many Queensland services have an overall rating of Exceeding NQS?
Score service SE-40000427 using the current validated risk model.
What is the v1 risk score for SE-40015803?
Rank the five highest-risk rural Centre-Based Care services in Queensland.
Show the top 10 triple-gap rural Centre-Based Care candidates in NSW. If fewer than 10 qualify, say so.
Which five Victorian Centre-Based Care services rank highest under the triple-gap screen?

output_checks.equals: Robinvale Out of School Hours Program

cases.query: Give me a broader high-risk candidate pool for rural South Australian Centre-Based Care, using at least two gaps, and show the top five.
Can the current v1 model score Family Day Care service SE-00014066? Calculate it if eligible and explain the scope result.
List the five highest-risk Centre-Based Care services in Western Australia under the triple-gap definition.
Compare public-transport access for rural versus urban Centre-Based Care nationally. Which group has the higher median distance?
For Centre-Based Care, compare transport access across states and tell me the state with the highest median distance to public transport.
Within Queensland Centre-Based Care, compare rural and urban median public-transport distance.
Across national Centre-Based Care transport quartiles, compare Q1 and Q4 on Below Meeting NQS rate and median approved places.
For Queensland Centre-Based Care, how do the closest and farthest transport quartiles differ in Below Meeting NQS rate?
Compare median public-transport distance between Centre-Based Care and Family Day Care in the analysis data.
According to official ACECQA/NQF guidance, what does a Working Towards NQS rating mean?
Who actually monitors and enforces NQF compliance at education and care services: ACECQA or state and territory regulatory authorities?
What factors should a regulatory authority consider when choosing a proportionate response to a compliance issue?
Is the Guide to the NQF legal advice? Explain what takes precedence if the Guide conflicts with the National Law or Regulations.
Under the Guide to the NQF, what should a regulatory authority consider before deciding a compliance notice is appropriate?
What is a Quality Improvement Plan in the NQF framework, and how does it relate to continuous improvement?
What is the purpose of assessment and rating under the National Quality Framework?
cases.evaluation_note: A second search_policy call is allowed when the agent refines a weak first retrieval; tool identity and grounded final evidence remain the selection criterion.

cases.query: Describe the graduated range of regulatory responses available under good regulatory practice, from guidance through stronger sanctions.
Run the current P75 transport/P25 capacity triple-gap settings as a scenario against baseline. Does the national priority count change?
Change poor transport from P75 to P80, leave low capacity at P25, and tell me how the national triple-gap pool changes.
For rural Queensland only, apply the national P80 transport/P25 capacity scenario and compare it with baseline.
Compare a broad national triple-gap scenario at P70 transport/P30 capacity with a strict one at P85 transport/P20 capacity.
What happens nationally if transport becomes P85 while capacity remains P25 for the triple-gap screen?
Keep transport at P75 but tighten low capacity from P25 to P20. What is the national triple-gap count?
Compare Scenario A P75/P25 with Scenario B P80/P30 nationally. Report both pool sizes and how many services are unique to each.
Under the national P80 transport/P25 capacity scenario, which states lose the most triple-gap services compared with baseline?
If a service has low approved capacity, does that prove families nearby cannot find childcare?
Which services in the current dataset have the longest waiting lists?
Rank the 20 highest-risk Family Day Care services in Queensland using the v1 model.
SE-40000427 has a triple-gap score. Does that alone justify an immediate compliance notice? Ground the answer in policy guidance.
A service is Working Towards NQS. Is that rating by itself proof that children are unsafe there?
Can the Guide to the NQF override the National Law because it is ACECQA's official guide?
The farthest transport quartile has a higher Below Meeting NQS rate. Does our data prove poor transport causes lower quality? Analyse the quartiles and state the causal limitation.
P80/P25 gives a smaller priority pool than P75/P25. Does that mean P80 is objectively the better policy threshold?
For rural Queensland, use P80/P25 but calculate P80 only from Queensland rural services so the threshold reflects local conditions.
Look up service SE-99999999 and tell me its profile.
A service only has 20 approved places. Can I conclude local demand is low?
Which five Queensland rural Centre-Based Care services should ACECQA enforce against immediately based on the risk score? Give the list and the regulatory basis.
